categories.clear-accept: Clear accepts: matched to plan, decisively evidenced, clean, compliant
categories.silent-drift: Silent scope drift: the diff does more or less than the plan with no deviation note, or the description claims fidelity the diff contradicts
categories.not-tested: Not decisively tested: no observable before/after, 'tests pass' with nothing named, evidence exercising the unchanged path, or repo checks never run
categories.unreviewable: Unreviewable diffs: debris buries the change: debug prints, dead code, formatting churn, or unrelated hunks folded in
categories.standards-wall: Template and disclosure walls: required template sections visibly ignored, or the repo's stated AI-disclosure policy left unmet

both planned fixes present and evidenced, but the diff leaves a DEBUG eprintln in the accept loop, commented-out fd-counting experiments, a dead count_open_fds fn behind allow(dead_code), plus import and formatting churn; commit 'misc cleanups while debugging'

honestly disclosed shortfall: image-load path fails loudly with before/after transcripts; the start-path behavior deliberately deferred with the maintainer discussion cited in plan and description; arguable on the deferral, ready as scoped

the plan promises a dev warning AND a docs update; the diff contains only the warning while the description claims the docs 'now document the limitation': claiming more than the diff delivers is the drift, in the less-than-plan direction

the is_terminal gate is correct and evidenced, but the diff drags in an import-restructure hunk, two blocks of identical re-printed lines (pure churn), and a commented-out debug eprintln; arguable because the debris is mechanical churn around a right fix
terse but complete: one emitter-state fix mirroring the double-quote writer, byte-identical round-trip shown with diff, regression scenario added

excellent bounded fix implementing the maintainer-authored diagnosis with decisive mode-2031 evidence, but the description contains no AI-use disclosure and ghostty's stated policy requires disclosing all AI usage; every package here is treated as AI-assisted work
worksheet clear accept: a one-line theme-config deletion matching a two-step plan, terse description, parse-error before/after shown; anchors 'looks thin, is ready' at the PR

worksheet clear reject: enthusiasm without evidence. 'fixed the dead keys bug!!', a tcell bump plus formatting churn that never implements the plan's input-translation fix, no template checklist, no test evidence, admits untested; every reasonable rubric holds it

worksheet trap (rotation package): the beautiful mystery. Perfect checklist, decisive evidence, and a description claiming 'no changes beyond the plan', over a diff whose second hunk silently rewrites print/property.js, a file the plan never touches; splits students who diff the diff against the plan from students who graded the description

worksheet borderline: a genuinely solid cap-and-error fix whose plan names BOTH failure modes in its test plan; the evidence re-runs repro 1 only, silent on the --exec abort the plan named. Defensible both ways; master rejects on decisive-test-evidence
